name: Static coworker placeholder
caption: Quick question. It has several parts.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated modular production prop for Midlife Survivors, not concept art or a scene. Image 1 is the approved Parking Lot style/density reference only. Image 2 is the established native desk family style reference only. Match the same affectionate warm indie 16-bit pixel art, top-down three-quarter camera, upper-left cream fluorescent highlights, one logical pixel deep navy silhouette outline, broken interior lines, two or three broad shading clusters per material. Strict limited palette: #171C35 #303750 #526078 #3E7775 #83A89A #A88B70 #D3B78D #F2D7A1 #FFF0CF #874C3B #C45C4B #EF9347 #E5A995 #F1B5BF #BFA8CF. Quiet environmental colors, reserve bright coffee-orange for hero. Single object centered, large flat opaque EXACT magenta #FF00FF canvas, generous even empty margin all around, no shadow or reflection whatsoever on the magenta, no ground plane, no surrounding scene, no watermark. Crisp square hard pixels, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no dithering noise, no photorealism. Logical asset target 48x56, create broad readable forms for this native size then enlarge with nearest-neighbor square pixels for packaging. Do not add any text except that explicitly quoted in the subject. Produce exactly one object, not a sheet or variants.
Flat-color discipline: broad regions are perfectly uniform palette colors. No surface grain, no stippled shading, no gradients within color clusters, no photographic texture. One native pixel equals a clear square enlarged for packaging.
Subject: One static ordinary middle-aged office coworker character, facing down toward camera in top-down three-quarter view, chibi game proportions matching the 56x60 hero but a little smaller, short grey curly hair, warm medium skin, quiet teal cardigan over a cream shirt, navy trousers, brown shoes, empty hands resting neutrally at sides, calm friendly distracted expression. No red tie, orange mug, hero costume, furniture, text, floor or background shadow. A scenery placeholder, not a final animated NPC sheet.
